name: lon_lon_buildings
label: Lon Lon Ranch buildings
about: Pieces and textures cut from Lon Lon Ranch buildings (souko). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09, from the textures and where souko draws them). Souko is three interiors: the tower's cow barn (room 0: `brick` and `plaster` walls, `wood` lofts, `hay`, `milk_can`s), the ranch house's ground floor (room 1: Talon's `bed_wood` bed, the `trough` of `water`, `lantern`s) and its upstairs (room 2: `chair_wood` stools, a table with a `rug`, a vase of `flower`s). `wood` is nearly everything wooden. No theme: these are interiors.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: llb_hay
pieces.label: Hay pile
pieces.about: A low heap of hay, 200 across and 48 high, from the cow barn in the tower; Link wades through it (tall-grass footsteps).

pieces.name: llb_hay_small
pieces.label: Small hay pile
pieces.about: A flat drift of hay, 113 across, from the tunnel into the cow barn.

pieces.name: llb_milk_cans
pieces.label: Milk cans
pieces.about: Two milk cans on a plank, from a shelf in the cow barn.

pieces.name: llb_barrel
pieces.label: Barrel
pieces.about: An eight-sided wooden barrel, 40 tall, from the cow barn (there are two).

pieces.name: llb_cart
pieces.label: Handcart
pieces.about: A two-wheeled wooden handcart standing on its end against the cow barn's wall, 142 tall.

pieces.name: llb_trough
pieces.label: Water trough
pieces.about: A small slatted wooden trough with water in it (translucent), 51 long, from the ranch house's floor. Drawn only: it has no collision in souko.

pieces.name: llb_bench
pieces.label: Bench
pieces.about: A long low bench of yellow planks, 161 long and 40 high, from the ranch house's ground floor.

pieces.name: llb_lantern
pieces.label: Wall lantern
pieces.about: An iron lantern on a bracket and chain, its flame glowing. Its origin is on the floor under the wall it hangs from: set against a wall, it hangs where it did in the ranch house (133 to 196 up). Drawn only.

pieces.name: llb_table
pieces.label: Round table
pieces.about: An eight-sided table with a cloth on it and a vase of red flowers, 110 across, from upstairs in the ranch house.

pieces.name: llb_chair
pieces.label: Chair
pieces.about: A high-backed wooden chair, 53 tall, beside the table upstairs (there are two).

pieces.name: llb_cabinet
pieces.label: Cabinet
pieces.about: A tall wooden cupboard with carved doors and a drawer, 103 tall, against the west wall upstairs. Its back is open: set it against a wall.
